import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeSeedUniv
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeClassifyBridge

/-!
Probe: the two window-shift regluings coincide, and the basis-map bookkeeping.

`windowShiftEquiv` (DivSchemeClassifyBridge.lean:86) and `seedWindowShiftEquiv`
(DivSchemeSeedUniv.lean:~150) are both `LinearEquiv.ofEq` between the same two spaces.
The consumer's chart ring is built on `b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm` while the
U2 chain's universal second window uses `seedWindowShiftEquiv`; the joint needs them
to agree.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace ProbeP1Shift

open AlgebraicGeometry Scheme

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleft :
    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsDominant pi]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g : ℕ)

/-- CRUX 1: the two regluings are the same map. -/
theorem shift_eq :
    seedWindowShiftEquiv C pi hpi g = windowShiftEquiv (C := C) (π := pi) hpi g := rfl

/-- CRUX 2: `Basis.map` bookkeeping — `(b.map e).equivFun = e.symm.trans b.equivFun`. -/
theorem basis_map_equivFun {r : ℕ} {H H' : Type u} [AddCommGroup H] [Module k H]
    [AddCommGroup H'] [Module k H'] (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k H) (e : H ≃ₗ[k] H') :
    (b.map e).equivFun = e.symm.trans b.equivFun := by
  ext x i
  simp [Module.Basis.equivFun_apply, Module.Basis.map_repr]

end ProbeP1Shift
